query: What different themes do students raise in these open responses?

per_column.name: tech_experience
per_column.rationale: Distinguishes platform vs connectivity vs positive tech experience, a genuine thematic axis. Values track source well (camera freezes->connectivity, logs out->platform, pause recordings->positive), and 'not_present' correctly used for silent rows.

per_column.name: pedagogy_quality
per_column.rationale: Useful ordinal axis for comparing teaching quality themes. Readings are mostly warranted (documentary clips->high_quality, can't tell when lost->neglectful). Slight interpretive stretch labeling ED-0001 'low_quality_passive' from a connectivity complaint, but defensible.

per_column.name: subject_format_fit
per_column.rationale: Captures whether subject suits remote format, a distinct and analytically valuable theme. Values are sound readings (algebra doesn't click->poor, recorded history lectures->strong).

per_column.name: student_engagement_level
per_column.rationale: Engagement is a core theme in these responses and gives a real grouping axis. Values well grounded (show up on time->increased, cameras off/silent->disengaged).

per_column.name: social_peer_community_loss
per_column.rationale: Captures a clearly distinct theme (peer/social isolation) with its own analytical leverage. Grounded (zero peer interaction->significant_loss; missing hand-raise->loss). Some inference on ED-0005 but reasonable.

per_column.name: teacher_feedback_responsiveness
per_column.rationale: Feedback responsiveness is a legitimate theme, but several values overreach the text. ED-0003 ('can't tell when she's lost') and ED-0005 (about participation, essays graded 'manageably') do not actually describe slow/minimal feedback, so 'slow_or_minimal' is an unwarranted specific reading. High rate of 'not_present' is appropriate for silent rows.

per_column.name: unexpected_positive_outcome
per_column.rationale: A meaningful theme (silver-lining outcomes) that adds a non-redundant axis. Values mostly grounded (kitchen-chemistry->curriculum_innovation, documentary clips->innovation) and silent rows correctly 'not_present'. Slight redundancy with pedagogy_quality on some rows.

judge.rationale: The added columns collectively decompose the responses into several genuinely distinct, non-trivial thematic axes (tech, pedagogy, subject fit, engagement, social loss, feedback, positive outcomes), each offering a real basis to group and compare open responses for the query. Most values are sound extractions or clearly warranted categorisations of the source text, with appropriate 'not_present' handling for silent rows. The main weakness is teacher_feedback_responsiveness, which asserts specific feedback-timing judgments (e.g., 'slow_or_minimal') on rows whose text does not address feedback, an over-specific inference. Overall quality is high on both necessary conditions.
